rows: Hail up to the size of baseballs destroyed windshields and dented cars as well as breaking hundreds of windows in homes in and around Kendalia.
Hail as large as softballs smashed the windshield and dented the body of a DPS vehicle near Sisterdale.

The Sheriff's Department reported that a short-lived, small tornado touched down at the Cave-Without-a-Name northeast of Boerne. The tornado struck a small building and caused minor damage before lifting and dissipating. There were no injuries.
